On Windows, the voice engine cannot open the transcription model because a folder or file name in the model’s path contains an umlaut, an accent or another non-ASCII character. Store the model under a path without such characters and update its entry in the model’s manifest, then re-index this document.

provenance: Every English value each display-mapped message was ever stored as, oldest first. Each first value is byte-equal to apps/desktop/src/shared/i18n/en.ts at v0.1.66, except main.engine.filesUnreadable, which #1012 added after v0.1.66. None of these keys had another value at any tag with a catalog (v0.1.8 to v0.1.66, read tag by tag on 2026-11-25). actedOn: release 1 acts on the key, not only shows it.
